أستجنس (form X)
# أَسْتَجْنِسُ (ʔastajnisu) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.ni.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# أُسْتَجْنَسُ (ʔustajnasu) /ʔus.tad͡ʒ.na.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# أَسْتَجْنِسَ (ʔastajnisa) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.ni.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# أُسْتَجْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
